nl: Which files call the function total_value? Do not count the file that only defines it. List relative paths.
oracle_program: code.symbols "total_value" path: ["."] kind: function |> code.references include_definition: false
reference_bash: grep -rlE '(^|[^A-Za-z_])total_value\(' . | sort | while read -r f; do grep -E '(^|[^A-Za-z_])total_value\(' "$f" | grep -vqE '(def|func|function) total_value\(' && echo "$f"; done
